The '''Giants' Plateau''' is an area found east of [[Al Kharid]]. Prior to the release of [[Ferox Enclave]], the plateau was the location where players could participate in the [[Clan Wars]] and [[Last Man Standing]] [[minigame]]s.

Here, players can find [[Dr Ford]], who has set up camp after hearing whispers from the nearby hole; a [[tinderbox]] and [[bronze pickaxe]] spawn on the large table nearby. Players can also find an [[anvil]] further south, with a [[bronze scimitar]] and [[wooden shield]] spawn on the large table next to it.

Further south, players can find a small tribe of [[Hill Giant (Giants' Plateau)|hill giants]], who share the same [[drop table]] as their standard counterparts, but drop [[steel scimitar]]s and [[iron med helm]]s instead of [[steel longsword]]s and [[iron full helm]]s respectively. Here, players can start the [[Sleeping Giants]] [[quest]] and play the [[Giants' Foundry]] [[minigame]] within the nearby cave entrance.

On the eastern end of the plateau, players can find the [[Citharede Abbey]], a small abandoned [[Saradomin]]ist abbey, as well as a [[Citharede Abbey mine|mine]], with three [[iron rocks]] and four [[coal rocks]].

== Transportation ==
* [[Minigame Teleport]] to [[Giants' Foundry]]
* [[Necklace of passage]] to teleport to [[Eagle's Eyrie]], then climb [[Rocks (Giants' Plateau)|rocks]] to the west (requires level 54 [[Agility]])
* [[Amulet of glory]] to teleport to Al Kharid, then run east through the gate.
* [[Ring of dueling]] to teleport to the [[Emir's Arena]], then run south-east.

==Treasure Trails==
Players can also find a [[Clan Cup Trophy]], which commemorates the winners of the [[Clan Cup]]s of years past, as part of the solution to a hard [[cryptic clue]]: ''Between where the best are commemorated for a year, and a celebratory cup, not just for beer.''

==Trivia==
[[File:Giants' Plateau - Assassin's Creed Leap of Faith.png|thumb|right|220px|A tall platform with hay bales on the bottom, a homage to the iconic Leap of Faith from the Assassin's Creed franchise.]]
*On the western end of the hill, a platform can be seen with several hay bales on the bottom. This is a reference to the Leap of Faith from the {{wp|Assassin's Creed}} franchise, in which members of the Assassin Brotherhood leap from tall buildings into soft piles of hay uninjured.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod West|url=https://twitter.com/JagexWest/status/1408184447170662410|date=24 June 2021|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/109419|archivedate=24 June 2021|quote=Yep! That's what I was referencing 😅}}
*The statue at the centre of the [[Emir's Arena]] resembles the giants found on the Giants' Plateau, possibly suggesting that giants once inhabited the wider area.
